# Rashtriya Sanatan Sanskar Seva Sansthan (Trust)
> राष्ट्रीय सनातन संस्कार सेवा संस्थान (ट्रस्ट)

> Premier National Hindu Sanatan Dharma & Vedic Sanskar Trust.
> Official Website: https://rashtriyasanatantrust.in/
> Core Motto: राष्ट्र हित ! • सनातन हित !! • परिवार हित !!! (National Welfare, Sanatan Dharma Upliftment, Family Harmony)

## Organizational Overview
Rashtriya Sanatan Sanskar Seva Sansthan (Trust) is a registered premier public charitable and religious trust (सनातन धर्म न्यास) operating across India. Established under the Indian Trusts Act, 1882, the Sansthan serves as a national institutional pillar for preserving, awakening, and authentically facilitating the 16 Vedic Sanskars (षोडश संस्कार), disseminating timeless Vedic scriptural wisdom (Vedas, Upanishads, Bhagavad Gita, Ramayana), protecting cows (Gau Seva), strengthening family values, and empowering unorganized laborers and marginalized communities.

## Core Pillars & Activities
1. **16 Vedic Sanskars Revival (१६ वैदिक संस्कार)**:
   Facilitating sacred life rites from conception to elder rites authentically according to Vedic scriptures for all Sanatan families, regardless of economic background.
2. **Sacred Scriptural Studies (सनातन ग्रंथ अध्ययन-अध्यापन)**:
   Propagating study circles, youth shlok workshops, and public discourses on the Vedas, Upanishads, Ramcharitmanas, and Gita to counter cultural erosion.
3. **Gau Seva & Gau Sanrakshan (गौ सेवा व संवर्धन)**:
   Promoting cow protection, nutritional and healthcare support for indigenous cows, and traditional Panchagavya awareness.
4. **Shramik Kalyan & Social Upliftment (श्रमिक कल्याण)**:
   Organizing awareness rallies, facilitating government welfare schemes (PM-SYM, e-Shram, Atal Pension, educational scholarships) for unorganized construction and daily wage workers.
5. **Samajik Samrasta & Youth Character Building (सामाजिक समरसता)**:
   Uniting communities, eliminating caste divisions, and training youth in moral discipline, yoga, and nation-first ideals.

## 16 Vedic Sanskars Facilitated by the Trust
1. Garbhadhana (गर्भाधान) - Sacred conception prayer
2. Pumsavana (पुंसवन) - Maternal and fetal health blessing
3. Simantonnayana (सीमन्तोन्नयन) - Mother mental well-being and purification
4. Jatakarma (जातकर्म) - Birth welcoming and medha-janana blessing
5. Namakarana (नामकरण) - Auspicious Vedic naming rite
6. Nishkramana (निष्क्रमण) - First outing into nature & Surya-Chandra darshan
7. Annaprashana (अन्नप्राशन) - First intake of sanctified solid nourishment
8. Chudakarana (चूड़ाकर्म / मुंडन) - First head tonsure for cranial purity
9. Karnavedha (कर्णवेध) - Ear-piercing ceremony for health and vitality
10. Vidyarambha (विद्यारंभ / अक्षराभ्यास) - Sacred initiation into learning and alphabets
11. Upanayana (उपनयन / यज्ञोपवीत) - Sacred thread ceremony and Guru initiation
12. Vedarambha (वेदारंभ) - Dedicated beginning of Vedic scripture study
13. Keshanta / Godana (केशांत) - Rite marking adulthood and youth discipline
14. Samavartana (समावर्तन) - Graduation into virtuous householder readiness
15. Vivaha (विवाह) - Holy sacramental marriage solemnization
16. Antyeshti (अन्त्येष्टि) - Final farewell Vedic funeral and remembrance rites
